_comment: XP and levels (DESIGN section 7), parties (section 9) and anti-griefing XP rules (section 5). xpToNext(level) = round(base * level^exponent).

kill._comment: Base XP for a kill, before the level-difference factor. Dummies only teach up to dummyMaxLevel.

levelDiff._comment: XP x clamp(1 + perLevel * (victimLevel - killerLevel), min, max); 0 when the victim is greyGap+ levels below.

pvp._comment: Repeat kills of the same player within repeatWindowSeconds give repeatFactor^n XP, nothing after maxRepeats. Kills within spawnKillSeconds of the victim's respawn give nothing.

party._comment: Same-side parties. Kill XP is split between members within shareRadius of the kill, plus bonusPerMember for each extra member.

discovery._comment: First visit to a landmark (any faction hub or contested shrine).
